description: Test class containing unit tests for gateway session timeout behaviors, URL building, and URL rewriting in the Android app gateway module.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTimeoutTest
classes.description: Contains test cases for URL formatting, timeout resolution, and URL rewriting functions related to gateway sessions.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests the formatting of IPv6 host addresses with brackets and a port number.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests building WebSocket URLs with IPv6 addresses, both with TLS and without.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_normalizesPersistedBracketedIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests the normalization of bracketed IPv6 addresses when building WebSocket URLs.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesFloorWhenMissingOrTooSmall
methods.description: Tests that the timeout resolution function defaults or floors values when null or too small.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesInvokeBudgetWithinBounds
methods.description: Tests that the timeout resolution respects the upper bounds set by invoke budget.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_capsAtUpperBound
methods.description: Tests that the timeout caps at the maximum when large values are provided.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesTerminalCapabilitySegment
methods.description: Tests URL rewriting to replace the capability token segment.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesWhenQueryAndFragmentPresent
methods.description: Tests URL rewriting when query parameters and fragment are present in the URL.
